Type: sectional sofa with chaise
Use: lounging, seating; living room, family room
Style: traditional, contemporary, classic
Materials: woven upholstery fabric, contrast piping, dark wood legs
Colors: warm tan beige, dark brown
Shape: left-facing chaise, three back cushions, two seat cushions, sloped track arms, short tapered legs, long and substantial
Feel: welcoming, relaxed, warm
Goes with: cream walls, warm wood, soft neutral textiles; traditional or transitional living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Isabel Traditional Sectional, 100"W, Tan
product.description: Between the chaise lounge, sofa and ottoman, this sectional has plenty of room for family, friends and pets. Even better, it features performance fabric and hidden storage, making it a stylish and highly functional addition to your room. Polyester performance fabric on wood frame Streamlined design fits a modern or transitional room Hidden compartments beneath the chaise and ottoman are handy for storing remote controls Easy assembly in 30 minutes or less; screw on legs and attach sectional pieces together Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. 100"W x 39.70 73.60"D x 37.4"H
